quests.plugin: Dragonborn.esm (last edited by UndeathFixes.esp, after Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)
quests.canDoWhy: A chance encounter while you travel Solstheim's northern, glacier or ash regions points you to a dungeon that holds a Black Book.

starts.who: a chance encounter out in the wilds (the quest tracks a person and a note)
starts.where: out in the wilds of Solstheim: the north of the island, the glaciers or the ashlands
starts.how: Travel those parts of Solstheim. When the encounter fires, you learn which dungeon holds a Black Book.

quests.firstStep: Find the Black Book in the dungeon the encounter names

takesYou.place: the dungeon the encounter names (probably on Solstheim)
takesYou.why: a Black Book is hidden there

objectives: Find the Black Book in <the dungeon named>

rewards.what: a Black Book (which one isn't in these files)
rewards.when: when you find it in the dungeon

opens: the Black Book's own quest, once you read the book you find (which book is not in these files)

people.name: a person tied to the encounter (unnamed in the records)
people.role: part of the encounter that starts the quest

unsure.why: The quest starts from a script event in three Solstheim regions. These files don't say what the encounter looks like: who the person is, whether they're alive, or where the note is.

The dungeon and the Black Book are picked when the quest starts, and the files don't list the choices. The encounter only fires on Solstheim, but the quest also carries Skyrim hold slots, so a dungeon on the mainland can't be ruled out.

A later fix for the Undeath mod edits this quest last, but these files don't show what it changes. Undeath has its own Black Book, Whispers of the Veil, but its journal places that book deep in Scourg Barrow, so the link to this encounter is not shown.
Which Black Book quest follows depends on the book the alias picks, and the records here don't say.
The quest holds a slot for the Black Book you are sent to find, so the book itself is what you come away with. Which Black Book it is, and anything it later grants, isn't in these files.

The forge recipes for Vitreous Ebony Armor, Boots, Gauntlets, Helmet and Shield and the Savage Ebony Scimitar (you also need the Ebony Smithing perk, plus ebony ingots, stalhrim and fire, frost and void salts)

unsure.why: The only start condition here is that the encounter hasn't already fired. No level requirement shows up in these files, though the story event may carry conditions that weren't extracted.

These files don't say where the Last Vigil is or what hold it's in. The Ebony Warrior is placed at the Ebony Warrior's Camp in Skyrim, and a Last Vigil mod in the list adds an interior called Ebony Keep (home to a Dremora housekeeper, Zruill), but the link between them isn't spelled out.
He picks the city when the encounter fires on a location change. The files don't list which cities qualify.

He wears an outfit from the Last Vigil overhaul in the list, and that same overhaul adds Ebony Warrior's Armor, Boots, Gauntlets, Helmet, Shield and the sword Ebonarm's Might, but the outfit's contents aren't listed here, so which pieces he actually drops isn't confirmed. A mod that adds the "get lost" option also adds a second Ebony Warrior and a tied object with no cell. Whether you can still fight him after dismissing him isn't clear from these files.

unsure.why: Ralis is placed in the Solstheim wilds and has a package keeping him near the barrow until the dig is funded. After that his only packages are sleeping and sandboxing at the Retching Netch. Where he stands during each phase comes from the quest, and that isn't in these files.

The log calls the Relics of Ahzidal "sealed in Kolbjorn Barrow", and the records hold those items, but these files don't say where each one lies. Ralis's record marks him as a follower, and after the dig his only packages keep him at the Retching Netch (sleeping from midnight for 8 hours), but the dialogue that recruits him isn't shown.
The quest uses an easy Speech check somewhere. These files don't say which line, possibly the one that persuades Ralis or spares him.

Ralis is marked essential in his record. The kill ending must lift that, but the script isn't read here. Destroy the Acolyte Priests has its own "Destroy Ahzidal" objective; whether killing him here ticks it off isn't shown.
Danger: these files list Kolbjorn Barrow's enemies at levels 30 to 55, with Ahzidal at level 55.
